name: dbpilot
description: TUI and CLI for PostgreSQL and Typesense administration using React and Ink

scripts.build:bin: pnpm run build:bundle && mkdir -p bin && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=bin/dbpilot-darwin-arm64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile=bin/dbpilot-darwin-x64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=bin/dbpilot-linux-arm64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=bin/dbpilot-linux-x64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile=bin/dbpilot-windows-x64.exe
